olivia: Quick note - onboarding sample app hitting a weird case: streaming generate (chunked) + token rotation = occasional naked retries (no Authorization header) and server 401. Repro on Pixel 6 emulator and Android 14 device.

ben: that sounds like header loss on connection retry. What okhttp version?

olivia: 4.9.3 + retrofit 2.9. Using a blocking refresh inside an interceptor. Code snippet: ```kotlin
class BlockingAuthInterceptor : Interceptor {
  override fun intercept(chain: Interceptor.Chain): Response {
    val req = chain.request()
    val token = TokenStore.current()
    val withAuth = req.newBuilder().header("Authorization", "Bearer $token").build()
    val resp = chain.proceed(withAuth)
    if (resp.code == 401) {
      val newToken = TokenRefresher.refreshBlocking()
      TokenStore.update(newToken)
      return chain.proceed(withAuth.newBuilder().header("Authorization", "Bearer $newToken").build())
    }
    return resp
  }
}
```

yara: blocking refresh in interceptor is risky. Use an Authenticator for 401 and a single in-flight refresh mechanism. Also upgrade OkHttp - 4.11.x fixed several retry/header propagation issues.

olivia: we tried Authenticator but got duplicate refresh calls (two concurrent 401s). We debounce with a mutex, but still see the retried POST arrive at backend without updated header.

ben: could be interplay of retryOnConnectionFailure + TLS session resumption where OkHttp silently retries on a new connection without re-applying the Authorization. Streaming bodies complicate replay.

olivia: streaming body is non-repeatable, but duplicate POSTs show identical content and length. Backend logs show second request missing Authorization.

yara: temporary workarounds that helped us in other projects: 1) set retryOnConnectionFailure(false) on the streaming-client; 2) use a dedicated OkHttp client (no auth interceptors) for refresh calls; 3) mark refresh requests with e.g. X-Refresh:1 to skip auth logic; 4) upgrade to OkHttp 4.11.1+.

ben: echo upgrade. Also add a guard in your Authenticator: if request.header("X-Refresh") != null -> return null. And centralize refresh with a CompletableDeferred so only one network call happens.

olivia: added `retryOnConnectionFailure(false)` for streaming endpoint client and spun up a tiny separate client for refresh. Reduced duplicates in local emulator runs. Opening PR with OkHttp bump next.

build-bot: CI: sample-app/android-integration #211 flaky tests decreased from 35 -> 6 after workaround. See https://ci.internal/211/logs

yara: once OkHttp is bumped, we should add a short devex note in README: recommended OkHttp versions, Authenticator vs Interceptor patterns, and streaming route config (retryOnConnectionFailure=false).

olivia: will do. I'll include repro steps and emulator images in the PR description. Thanks all :heart:
